
# Capstone & Resources {#capstone}

---

### Capstone: Build a Mini Agent Runtime

::: {.callout-note}
#### The Challenge
Deliver a small, fully tested, typed, asynchronous agent runtime package that mirrors how **LangGraph**, **Strands**, and **ADK** work internally.
:::

::: columns
::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.callout-tip}
### 1. Typed State
`TypedDict`, functional reducers (`operator.add`), and `Annotated` state channels.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
### 2. Validated Tools
Automatic JSON Schema extraction from Python functions with Pydantic validation.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.callout-important}
### 3. Async Engine
DAG node execution using `graphlib`, per-step `asyncio.timeout`, and cancellation.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
### 4. Extensibility
Async lifecycle hooks (`before_tool`, `after_tool`) and Protocol-based dependency injection.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="34%"}
::: {.callout-caution}
### 5. Reliability
Retries with exponential backoff and jitter; atomic SQLite state checkpointing.
:::

::: {.callout-caution}
### 6. Packaging & Ship
Managed via `uv`, linted with `ruff`, strictly checked with `mypy`, with a CLI entry point.
:::
:::
:::

> **Suggested Rubric (100 pts):** Correctness (30), Typing & Architecture (20), Async & Reliability (20), Tests & CI (15), Packaging & CLI (15).

---

### From These Skills to the Framework Bootcamps

| Python Skill | How It Translates Directly to Frameworks |
| :--- | :--- |
| **`TypedDict` & `Annotated`** | Define LangGraph graph state and channel reducers; specify tool schemas |
| **Pydantic & `TypeAdapter`** | Parse structured output in Strands; define input/output contracts in ADK |
| **Decorators & Generics** | Author `@tool`, `@hook`, and `@node`; understand `Runtime[Context]` and `Case[str, str]` |
| **`async`, `gather`, `TaskGroup`** | Execute parallel tool calls, dynamic branch fan-out, and multi-agent coordination |
| **Async Generators (`yield`)** | Stream token generation via `stream_async()` and server-sent events (SSE) |
| **Context Managers** | Manage Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, DB transactions, and session state |
| **Exceptions & Cancellation** | Handle agent stop reasons, human-in-the-loop interrupts, and timeouts safely |
| **`uv`, `ruff`, `pytest`, CI** | Test, package, containerize, and deploy production-ready autonomous agents |

### Troubleshooting Cheat Sheet

| Symptom / Error | Root Cause | Idiomatic Resolution |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `RuntimeWarning: coroutine was never awaited` | Forgot to `await` a coroutine function | Add `await` or schedule with `asyncio.create_task()` |
| `RuntimeError: asyncio.run() cannot be called...` | Called `asyncio.run()` inside an active loop | Await the coroutine directly |
| Stream freezes and timeouts fire late | Synchronous blocking call inside async function | Offload with `await asyncio.to_thread()` |
| Shared list grows across independent calls | Mutable default parameter (`items=[]`) | Use `items=None` or `field(default_factory=list)` |
| `TypeError: Object is not JSON serializable` | Non-primitive (datetime, set, object) in state | Convert to string/dict or use Pydantic `model_dump_json()` |
| `ImportError: cannot import name ...` | Circular dependency between modules | Refactor shared code or guard with `if TYPE_CHECKING:` |
| `uv run` uses unexpected dependency versions | Inline script metadata header overrides project | Check `# /// script` metadata block |
| Type checker passes but runtime crashes | Static annotations are not enforced at runtime | Validate inputs at boundaries using Pydantic |

### Commands and Syntax at a Glance

::: columns
::: {.column width="33%"}
#### `uv`
```bash
uv init
uv add / uv remove
uv sync --frozen
uv run <cmd>
uv python install 3.13
uv tool install ruff
uv build && uv publish
uv audit
```
:::

::: {.column width="33%"}
#### Types
```python
X | None
Literal["a", "b"]
Annotated[T, metadata]
class State(TypedDict): ...
class Store(Protocol): ...
def f[T](x: T) -> T: ...
type Result[T] = tuple[bool, T]
```
:::

::: {.column width="34%"}
#### Pydantic
```python
class M(BaseModel): ...
Field(ge=0, le=100)
@field_validator("x")
@model_validator(mode="after")
model_dump_json()
TypeAdapter(list[M])
```
:::
:::

::: columns
::: {.column width="33%"}
#### Async
```python
async def / await
asyncio.create_task()
async with TaskGroup() as tg:
async with timeout(5.0):
asyncio.Semaphore(5)
async for item in stream:
await asyncio.to_thread(fn)
```
:::

::: {.column width="33%"}
#### Testing
```python
@pytest.fixture
@pytest.mark.parametrize
@pytest.mark.asyncio
with pytest.raises(Error):
AsyncMock()
monkeypatch.setenv()
Hypothesis properties
```
:::

::: {.column width="34%"}
#### Quality
```bash
uv run ruff check --fix
uv run ruff format
uv run mypy src --strict
pre-commit run --all-files
GitHub Actions CI matrix
```
:::
:::

### Readiness Checklist: Agent Frameworks

::: columns
::: {.column width="50%"}
#### Tooling & Environment
- [ ] I can create, manage, and run projects with `uv`
- [ ] I can pin Python versions and commit universal lockfiles
- [ ] `ruff` and static type checkers run in continuous integration
- [ ] Secrets and `.env` files are excluded from Git history

#### Types & Data Modeling
- [ ] I can design typed state machines with `TypedDict` and dataclasses
- [ ] I can declare and consume structural `Protocol` interfaces and generics
- [ ] I can model complex domain contracts with Pydantic v2
- [ ] I enforce strict schema validation at all system boundaries
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
#### Asynchronous Programming
- [ ] I can explain event loop mechanics and cooperative multitasking
- [ ] I use `TaskGroup`, timeouts, and cancellation cleanly
- [ ] I handle and re-raise `asyncio.CancelledError` properly
- [ ] I can build and consume real-time token async generators

#### Quality & Deployment
- [ ] I write fast, offline unit tests using in-memory fakes
- [ ] I test async functions and streams with `pytest-asyncio`
- [ ] I attach contextual `run_id` correlation across log streams
- [ ] I can containerize and ship agent CLIs with least privilege
:::
:::
